points.point: Does Blotato repost failed Instagram posts automatically forever?

verdict.reason: The customer asks for confirmation of an automatic repost forever for failed Instagram posts, and no candidate says that; the closest entry (instagram-temporary-error-20003) only says Blotato retries on its own before reporting a temporary error and tells the user to check for an existing post before retrying, so it does not confirm the "forever" claim.
